android.desc:
​

The Embodied Moxie Parent App is a companion app to Moxie, a revolutionary new robot for children designed to help promote social, emotional, and cognitive development through everyday play-based learning and captivating content.

Inside the Embodied Moxie Parent App:
- You can set up Moxie and connect it to the internet. 
- You can choose settings and preferences specifically for your child.
- With an active subscription you’ll have access to a personalized dashboard that tracks your child’s progress with Moxie and provides key insights into their social, emotional, and cognitive development.

To opt-in to the beta test, please visit: https://play.google.com/apps/testing/com.embo.embodied.parent
